layers.process: A backcountry permit is needed for hiking or camping in all Navajo Tribal Park areas, US$15 per person per night per location (about A$21 at RBA, 30 October 2026: A$1 = US$0.7040). Carry it at all times on the Nation. Some areas are closed to hiking.

sources.title: Rules and regulations
sources.supports: carry the permit at all times

zone-requirements.note: Ask Navajo Nation Parks and Recreation about permits for filming or commercial photography (not read on these pages).
